name: Normalized three-mode inputs
description: Illustrative customer orders, delivered prices/costs, capacity, fixed cost and capex; no country calibration.

name: Six worlds, no probability
description: Driver multipliers are judgemental stresses, not estimated likelihoods.

name: 25% simplified tax
description: Unlimited loss carryforward, no refunds, interest or jurisdiction differences. Replace with legal tax schedule.

name: Real USD hurdle
description: 10% managed convention; 9–14% scenario hurdle. Not Olam WACC or financing quote.

name: Cash conventions
description: 80% credit revenue/purchases; AR + inventory − AP; 365 days; 90% final recovery.

name: Beyond 2035
description: Order growth halves after year 10; bounded by capacity. Not an OECD forecast.

name: Asset cycle
description: 60/40 original capex; 10-year straight-line depreciation; 2% maintenance; 70% replacement in years 11/21.

name: Causal pilot
description: Randomised route clusters where feasible; power from measured baseline variance; no declared Olam effect.

name: Dependence model
description: Chosen normal latent factors with joint cost/volume/stock/rate shocks; seed 20261008; no country probability.

name: Teaching arithmetic
description: Examples deliberately chosen; not Olam data unless expressly reported.

name: Illustrative policy weights/payoffs
description: Decision examples are teaching cases. No proprietary novelty or calibrated probability.

name: Inherited Nigeria inputs
description: Preserved as normalized assumptions; additive growth and sales-day proxy are not production economics.
